title: State dinners to scrutiny: Nvidia’s Huang falls out of favour in Trump’s Washington
snippet: AI kingmaker’s opponents see ‘blood in the water’ after affair with suspected Chinese spy

title: Nvidia shares tumble in after-market trading
snippet: Stock sinks almost 9 per cent in after-market trading as chief executive’s fate hangs in balance following more revelations

title: US tech stocks tumble as investors fret over AI spending
snippet: US tech shares fell as investors worried about the returns on AI spending.

title: TSMC says AI demand still exceeds its supply capability as Q3 profit reaches a record
snippet: TSMC's third-quarter revenue was about $46.7 billion, up 41%, with record net income. It held its 2026 capex at $60-64 billion; shares slipped as investors focused on margins and spending.

title: Nasdaq notches record high close as investors focus on earnings
snippet: The Nasdaq closed at a record 27,477.31 helped by Nvidia and Microsoft, though breadth was weak: 243 new lows against 57 new highs.

title: Nvidia shares approach record high as AI optimism revives investor demand
snippet: Nvidia hit a record near $237.75 on October 2, helped by an expanded $150 billion buyback, after a two-month selloff that had erased more than $1 trillion of its market value.

title: Big Tech's AI debt binge set to hit new eye-popping milestone
snippet: Big Tech's debt issuance to fund AI is projected to reach a new record.

title: Wall St Week Ahead: Investors focus on rate path, AI slowdown after Fed hike
snippet: The Federal Reserve raised its target range by 25 basis points to 3.75%-4.00%, its first hike since 2023, and 16 of 18 officials project at least one more increase this year.

title: US yields just hit a 19-year high: these 5 stocks could take the biggest hit
snippet: The 10-year Treasury yield briefly hit 5%, peaking near 5.01%, its highest level since 2007, adding pressure on growth and AI stocks.

title: Oracle Announces Q1 Results Driven by Triple Digit Growth in Cloud Infrastructure Revenues
snippet: Revenue rose about 30% to $19.3 billion and remaining performance obligations reached about $664 billion. Capital expenditure was $28 billion, leaving free cash flow negative by about $5 billion, and Oracle completed a $20 billion at-the-market stock sale.

title: Amazon raises GBP4.25 billion in debut sterling bond sale
snippet: Amazon raised GBP4.25 billion in its first sterling bond sale on September 9, with final orders above GBP10.65 billion, as hyperscalers keep tapping debt markets to fund AI build-outs.

title: Marvell's stock sinks despite earnings beat and strong guidance
snippet: Marvell raised its fiscal 2027 revenue outlook to $12 billion and fiscal 2028 to $18 billion, but shares fell more than 7% after hours as investors, after a rally of more than 40% since late July, wanted more upside.

title: Nvidia stock slips 1% despite beating earnings expectations and raising guidance
snippet: Nvidia's fiscal second-quarter revenue was $96.2 billion, up 106% year over year versus $92.3 billion expected. Data Center revenue hit a record $89.0 billion. It guided third-quarter revenue to $108 billion, assuming no China data center compute revenue.

title: Are AI data center bans going too far?
snippet: Opposition to data centers over electricity costs is spreading, with New York reportedly imposing a statewide moratorium on new construction in mid-July and Virginia weighing repeal of its tax break.

title: Micron and MongoDB Sink as AI Chip Complex Buckles Before Nvidia Earnings, SOXX -2.67%
snippet: AI chip stocks tumbled Monday ahead of Nvidia's earnings, with the semiconductor index down 2.67%.

title: AI Stock Sell-off Triggers Global Share Declines as Markets Eye Middle East Tensions
snippet: Global equity markets fell on August 19 as heavy selling hit AI-related stocks. The S&P 500 dropped about 0.7% with semiconductors weak.

title: Anthropic Widens Lead Over OpenAI as Revenue Run Rate Hits $65 Billion
snippet: Bloomberg reported Anthropic's annualized revenue run rate reached about $65 billion at the end of July, up from about $47 billion in late May, while OpenAI's comparable figure was above $40 billion. The companies may calculate run rate differently.

title: CoreWeave Reports Strong Second Quarter 2026 Results
snippet: Revenue was about $2.6 billion, up 112%. Net loss was $626 million with $640 million of interest expense. Q2 capex was $9.4 billion and full-year capex guidance rose to $35-39 billion. Backlog was about $104 billion.

title: SoftBank earnings beat on Intel gain while OpenAI stake is flat
snippet: SoftBank's April-June net profit fell about 18% to 347.3 billion yen. Its OpenAI stake produced no gain or loss, versus about $20 billion of appreciation the prior quarter. It plans another $10 billion for OpenAI in October, and Vision Fund 2 reportedly plans to borrow $10 billi…

title: Palantir earnings: high expectations and even bigger gains
snippet: Palantir reported second-quarter revenue up 93% year over year to $1.94 billion, with adjusted EPS up 156% and full-year revenue guidance raised.

title: Why are Nvidia-backed CoreWeave, Nebius and IREN stocks plunging?
snippet: Top neocloud stocks fell sharply over recent days as concerns about the industry's outlook intensified, citing rising server, memory and chip costs and new competition. IREN is down 47% from its peak this year; short interest is 27% for CoreWeave, 28% for Nebius and 22% for IREN.
